review_fixes: R-1 (BLOCKING): ValidationError now extends RegisterError so the HTTP route's instanceof RegisterError guard catches it and emits 400 VALIDATION. Before: ValidationError fell through to 500 INTERNAL. Fix is in src/core/register.ts — swapped class declaration order, ValidationError extends RegisterError with super('VALIDATION', message).

R-2 (orphan KC user): createHumanUser in src/keycloak/admin-port.ts now reads the user UUID from the Location response header of the 201 (extractIdFromLocation helper). Falls back to GET-by-username only when Location is absent. doRequest return type extended with responseHeaders. If DB fails after id is obtained, deleteUser is called with the Location-derived id — no orphan possible.

R-3 (LIVE-SCHEMA BUG FIX): register.ts DB transaction omitted NOT-NULL columns required by the real choros schema, causing 500 on the live stack (unit tests used a fake pool and missed this). Fixed: (1) role INSERT now includes updated_at=$3; (2) employee INSERT now includes updated_at=$5; (3) role_assignment INSERT now includes granted_by=$6 (= employeeId, self-bootstrap genesis owner) and updated_at=$7. SQL param lists and value arrays adjusted consistently. Test guard added: new describe 'SQL column guard' in register.test.ts asserts the SQL strings passed to the fake pool include updated_at (role/employee/role_assignment) and granted_by (role_assignment).

R-4 (i18n BUG FIX — live e2e verified): slugifyOrgName stripped all Cyrillic characters, collapsing 'Браузер Приёмка'/'Браузер Два'/'Приёмка Три' all to '' → 'org', causing spurious 409 ORG_TAKEN on every Cyrillic org name after the first. Two-part fix: (a) Cyrillic→latin transliteration map applied before [^a-z0-9-] filter so distinct names get distinct base slugs; (b) registerTenant retries the DB tx on 23505 unique-violation up to 5 times with a random base36 suffix, guaranteeing two companies with the same display name can both register. kc.deleteUser compensation only fires after all retries are exhausted.
